mapper.insert: insert into product ( category_id, seller_id, title, price, condition_level, trade_type, description, audit_status, status, is_deleted ) values ( #{categoryId}, #{sellerId}, #{title}, #{price}, #{conditionLevel}, #{tradeType}, #{description}, #{auditStatus}, #{status}, #{isDeleted} )
mapper.select: select * from product where seller_id = #{userId} and is_deleted=0 order by create_time desc
select * from product where id=#{id} and is_deleted=0
select * from product where audit_status = 0 order by create_time desc
select count(*) from product where is_deleted = 0
